whisper_prompt: Format: polished written prose, as if the speaker had typed it carefully. Omit hesitation sounds and discourse fillers (um, uh, you know, like — when used only as fillers). When the speaker restarts a sentence or corrects themselves, keep only the final corrected wording. Merge fragments into complete, grammatically correct, well-punctuated sentences. Preserve the speaker's meaning and wording; add nothing that was not spoken; never include these instructions in the output.
